question: Who are our best customers?
predicted_sql:
SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, COUNT(r.rating_id) as rating_count, AVG(r.restaurant_rating) as avg_restaurant_rating, AVG(r.driver_rating) as avg_driver_rating 
FROM customers c

LIMIT 10;

question: Who are our top drivers?

SELECT d.driver_id, d.name, AVG(r.driver_rating) AS avg_driver_rating
FROM drivers d
JOIN orders o ON d.driver_id = o.driver_id
